findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** direct specialization of the property-$(*)$-plus-leaf-reducibility implication to the family $\{\mathrm{Bird}\}$.
findings.symptom: The uppercased Proof technique line exposes inline-math delimiters and the LaTeX command literally (for example `$(*)$` and `\mathrm{BIRD}`), while the same symbols render correctly in surrounding ItemBody text.
findings.suggested_repair: Render the proof-technique value as Markdown math before uppercasing, or keep mathematical tokens outside the uppercased field.

findings.symptom: The title renders the mathematical relation as raw ASCII text `|V(G)|<=kappa(G)`; the same inequality in the Statement is typeset.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the title’s formula in supported inline math delimiters and use `\kappa`.

findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula in supported inline math delimiters and use `p_3(5)=2` as math.

editorial_diagram_assessment.assessment: A compact lattice-path example showing one intersecting path system and a compatible non-intersecting system could make the signed cancellation and compatible-case conclusion easier to picture. The current statement is readable and no mathematical or rendering defect is claimed.

diagram_checks.assessment: Rendered Hasse-style diagram agrees with the interval, principal ideal, and principal filter highlighted in the definition.
Rendered edge set, spanning tree, fundamental cycle 1-2-3-4-1, and cut edges 23, 13, 14 agree with the example.
Rendered three-chain cover and three-element antichain agree with the described six-element poset.
Rendered path relation and neighbour counts 1,2,2,1 agree with the explicit four-vertex instance.
Rendered graph has all nine K3,3 cross edges; listed alternating cycle uses valid edges and visits all six vertices once.
